chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Uzafir, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him), who said:

A man complained to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) about the profession (of trading), so he (peace be upon him) said: 'Look at the saleable items, buy them, then sell them. So whatever you profit from, hold to it (continue with it).'

key_terms.فَالْزَمْهُ: Hold to it, continue with it, persist in it

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet advise a man to do if he wanted to change his profession to something more profitable and lawful?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) advises a man dissatisfied with his trade to identify a profitable and permissible commodity, establishing the principle of *istiqra'* (continuing in beneficial activities) within Shia commercial jurisprudence. This ruling underscores the permissibility of seeking gain through lawful trade while avoiding *gharar* (excessive uncertainty) and *riba* (usury), aligning with the broader Shia emphasis on economic justice and practical livelihood. The advice reflects the Prophetic tradition of encouraging Muslims to engage in honest commerce that sustains the community without falling into prohibited practices.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Amro Bin Usman, from Muhammad Bin Uzafir, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A man complained to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> of the profession, so he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Look at the salealble items, so buy it then sell it. So whatever is profitable therein, so necessitate (continuing) it (so continue with the trading of those items/business)’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah, from ‘Amr ibn ‘Uthman from Muhammad ibn’ Adhafir from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

A man once complained before the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, against his deprivation. He (the Holy Prophet) said, ‘Consider selling. You must buy then sell. In whatever merchandise you find profit, hold to it.’”
